meta-ads.note: Official Meta Ads MCP server. OAuth on first use, tied to one business portfolio — connect once per portfolio. Needs access to the ad accounts themselves, granted separately in Meta Business Manager.

hubspot.note: Official HubSpot MCP server. OAuth on first use. Supplies the independent view of what advertising actually produced, which platform-reported conversions cannot check on their own.

github.note: Official GitHub MCP server. OAuth on first use. This is how findings and gaps are read and written without a local clone: a write through this connector is a commit. Name the repository in the project instructions — the plugin does not carry an address.
